flat:
What we are building: A shared shopping list where two people tick items off in real time

Data model: List has many Items. Item: name, quantity, done, addedBy.

This pass only: Just the list screen and the add-item sheet. Do not build anything else yet.

Look: Dense, 14px base, 8px radius, one accent colour, no gradients.

Leave alone: The auth screens, which already work.

Rules: No new dependencies.

Before you build: Restate what you are about to build in three bullets and wait for me to confirm.
notes: Three modes: Plan for concepts, Agent for development, Visual Edits for cosmetic refinement.
Visual Edits is cheaper than re-prompting for anything cosmetic.
warnings: Always include the leave-alone clause. Omit it and it will rewrite parts that already worked.

variations.name: Add one example
variations.text: Paste a short example of exactly the answer you want. One example outperforms a paragraph describing the format.

variations.name: Name the reader
variations.text: Add who reads this and what they will do with it. It changes what the model chooses to include more than any other line.

variations.name: Ask for the objections
variations.text: Add: end with the three strongest objections to your own answer, and say which one you find hardest to dismiss.
